msg.session_invalid: Your session has expired or is invalid. Sign in again.
msg.order_id_fixed: order_id cannot be changed; correct the other fields.
msg.not_schema_field: {field} is not a field of the C21 schema.
msg.bad_column: {prefix}"{column}" is not an allowed column name.
msg.csv_no_orders: {name} has a header but no orders.
msg.header_missing_in: {field} is missing from the header of {name}.
msg.header_missing: {field} is missing from the CSV header.
msg.template_mismatch: {name} does not match the order template: {path} {reason}.
msg.unsupported_file: {name} is not JSON or CSV. Use JSON or CSV with the template columns.
msg.attach_file: Attach the file in a form field named "file".
msg.files_too_many_rows: The {files} files have {count} orders together; the limit is {limit}.
msg.unsupported_type: Use JSON or CSV in the C21 schema (application/json, text/csv or multipart/form-data with a "file" field).
msg.all_rejected: Every row was rejected. First problem: {detail}
msg.saved_plus_upload: Saved orders plus this upload come to {count}; the limit is {limit}.
msg.scenario_other_analysis: scenario_id belongs to a different analysis.
msg.no_pulse_view: No Pulse view "{view}". Use overview, months, products, channels, leaks or insights.
msg.sample_missing: Sample "{source}" was not found at data/{file}.
msg.db_down_decision: The database is not reachable, so the decision was not saved. Check that Mongo is running, then save again.
msg.db_rejected_decision: The database rejected the write, so the decision was not saved. Try again.
msg.file_too_large: A file is larger than {mb} MB.
msg.body_not_json: The body is not valid JSON.
msg.internal: Something failed on the server. The request id is in the logs.
msg.not_an_order: {where} is not an order — row excluded.
msg.sign_in_required: Sign in to use your account.
msg.invalid_state: The sign-in link has expired or was not started here. Start sign-in again.
msg.provider_disabled: {provider} sign-in is not set up on this server.
msg.missing_code: The sign-in reply had no code. Start sign-in again.
msg.confirm_delete: Send {"confirm":"DELETE"} to delete your account and all its data.
msg.db_down_account: The database is not reachable, so nothing was exported or deleted. Try again shortly.
msg.mapping_bad_json: mapping must be a JSON object of schema field to column name.
msg.mapping_bad_column: {field} is mapped to "{column}", which is not a column in this file.
msg.mapping_bad_field: {field} is not a field of the C21 schema; map only schema fields.
hint.load_first: Load a dataset and run an analysis first.
hint.fix_field: Fix the named field and send again.
hint.one_assumption: Change one assumption at a time.
hint.split_by_month: Split it by month and upload the files together.
hint.utf8_json: Check the file is UTF-8 JSON.
hint.guest_demo: Guests can keep using the demo without signing in.
hint.nothing_saved: Nothing was saved. Send a valid value.
hint.use_order_id: Use an order_id from the dataset, or the line of a rejected row.
hint.save_utf8: Save the CSV as UTF-8 and upload again.
hint.delimiter: Check the delimiter is a comma and every row has the same columns.
hint.add_column: Add the column {cols} (see the CSV template).
hint.add_columns: Add the columns {cols} (see the CSV template).
hint.json_shape: Use {"records":{"orders":[...]}} as in the sample file, or an array of orders.
hint.fewer_months: Upload fewer months at a time.
hint.fix_fields_upload: Fix the named fields and upload again.
hint.new_dataset: Start a new dataset for a later period.
hint.map_missing: Map the missing fields or pick a profile, then upload again.
hint.start_again: Open the sign-in page and choose a provider again.
reason.inr: must be a number in INR
reason.iso_date: must be an ISO date YYYY-MM-DD
reason.real_date: must be a real calendar date
reason.one_order: must contain at least one order
